query:
When the group pivoted from a Peak District hike to an escape room, which member's response to that change most clearly signals they would not have chosen the escape room themselves, and what in their phrasing gives this away?

Options:
A. Nadia
B. Theo
C. Zara
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Zara, episodic, t10 @2026-02-12T19:55:00) Tarkovsky retrospective. I would have gone to that. You should have said.
[2] (about=Zara, episodic, t4 @2026-01-22T19:50:00) I would have left. That is not a judgment, it is just what I would have done.
[3] (about=Theo, episodic, t6 @2026-01-29T19:53:00) I'll do the hike with whoever wants to hike. doesn't have to be a group thing.

[5] (about=Seb, episodic, t10 @2026-02-12T19:47:00) knee is about 70% honestly tho, but I can do an escape room standing around, it's not a hike
[6] (about=Marcus, core, t10 @2026-02-12T19:41:00) says 'should be able to make it' to Saturday's escape room, same pattern as before

[8] (about=Priyanka, core, t6 @2026-01-29T19:23:00) proposed escape rooms near Waterloo as alternative for Feb 14, has good reviews, will look into booking it
[9] (about=Priyanka, core, t10 @2026-02-12T19:41:00) volunteered to call the escape room place, confirmed 2pm Saturday slot
[10] (about=GROUP, said_by=Priyanka, group-interaction, t6 @2026-01-29T19:23:00) Group decided to do an escape room near Waterloo on Feb 14 instead of the hike, with Priyanka to look into booking it; Nadia asked for start and end times
[11] (about=Seb, core, t6 @2026-01-29T19:23:00) has been trying to get group to do a proper hike for about a year, excited about Peak District
[12] (about=Seb, core, t6 @2026-01-29T19:23:00) has been wanting to do an escape room for ages, enthusiastic about the alternative
[13] (about=GROUP, said_by=Seb, group-interaction, t6 @2026-01-29T19:23:00) Group decided to do a day trip to the Peak District on Feb 14, with Seb initially in, but later Seb pulled out due to knee; hike still happens without Seb, picking something less steep
[14] (about=Theo, episodic, t6 @2026-01-29T19:50:00) the hike still happens on the 14th without Seb. we'll just pick something less steep.
[15] (about=Zara, said_by=Seb, profile, t12 @2026-02-19T19:55:00) Seb says Zara saying the escape room was considerably less awful than expected is basically a five-star review.
[16] (about=Zara, core, t6 @2026-01-29T19:23:00) will look at train times and find a route that does not require experienced hiker, being realistic about fitness levels
agent_answer:
**B. Theo**

Theo’s response is: **“I’ll do the hike with whoever wants to hike. doesn’t have to be a group thing.”**

The giveaway is that he explicitly sticks with the **hike** rather than going along with the pivot to the escape room. The phrase *“doesn’t have to be a group thing”* shows he’s willing to opt out of the changed plan — meaning the escape room was not his own choice.

query:
When Priyanka suggested the group go to Zara's pub quiz, which member's agreement to that plan reveals they did not actually embrace it, and what specific detail in their message gives that away?

Options:
A. Nadia
B. Marcus
C. Theo
D. Zara
context:
[1] (about=Zara, episodic, t2 @2026-01-15T19:48:00) Fine by me. I would push back on sitting in a garden in January but I suppose a pub quiz ends at a fixed time, which is the main thing.
[2] (about=Priyanka, episodic, t2 @2026-01-15T19:36:00) would anyone want to come next week? has anyone thought about trying it? totally fine if not, I don't want to be weird about it 😅
[3] (about=Marcus, episodic, t12 @2026-02-19T20:08:00) cheers Zara 🙏
[4] (about=Nadia, episodic, t2 @2026-01-15T19:41:00) That house. Zara had a full-length coat she refused to take off inside for three days.

[7] (about=Seb, core, t6 @2026-01-29T19:23:00) agreed to come to Marcus's tomorrow for assessment
[8] (about=GROUP, said_by=Seb, group-interaction, t2 @2026-01-15T19:31:00) Group decided to meet this Sunday at the Crown on Marchmont for a pub quiz at 7pm, with a garden out back for after, and Zara and Nadia confirming they're in if it starts and ends on time
[9] (about=Theo, core, t10 @2026-02-12T19:41:00) will send Zara the link to the Tarkovsky retrospective, it's still running for two more weeks
[10] (about=Zara, said_by=Theo, profile, t0 @2026-01-08T19:14:00) Theo says Zara's answer about the client's instructions is 'a very Zara answer'
[11] (about=Zara, core, t0 @2026-01-08T19:14:00) client's instructions held up in form but whether they reflect his actual wants will resolve in about six weeks
agent_answer: D. Zara — her agreement was “Fine by me,” but she added: *“I would push back on sitting in a garden in January but I suppose a pub quiz ends at a fixed time, which is the main thing.”* That hesitation about the January garden shows she didn’t really embrace the plan; she accepted mainly because the quiz has a fixed end time.
